title: Normalized affine pullback models from an isomorphic source chart
statement: Let $A,T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $A$ be affine and let $s:T\to A$ be an isomorphism. Let $M,N$ be quasi-coherent structure-sheaf modules on $A$ [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $P=\Gamma(T,s^*M)$ and $Q=\Gamma(T,s^*N)$ with their actual $\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$-module structures [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. There exist bijections $\delta_M:P\simeq\Gamma(A,M)$ and $\delta_N:Q\simeq\Gamma(A,N)$, chosen independently of the following data. For every affine scheme $W$, morphism $q:W\to A$, commutative ring $S$, ring homomorphism $r:\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)\to S$, and ring isomorphism $\rho:S\simeq\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)$ satisfying $\rho(r(s^\sharp(b)))=q^\sharp(b)$ for all $b\in\Gamma(A,\mathcal O_A)$, there are additive equivalences $e_M:S\otimes_r P\simeq\Gamma(W,q^*M)$ and $e_N:S\otimes_r Q\simeq\Gamma(W,q^*N)$, semilinear along $\rho$, sending $1\otimes m$ to the pullback unit applied to $\delta(m)$. No finite presentation is assumed. No Hom comparison is asserted.

proof.text: Use the existing whole-scheme affine tensor-sections comparison. Change the coefficient ring by the given ring equivalence rho, swap tensor factors, and identify tensorPullback with the standard pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints. The unit equation of that adjunction comparison identifies the pure-tensor formula with rho(b) times pullbackGamma(q,M,m). Tensor induction identifies this bijection with the explicitly constructed extension/restriction-of-scalars adjunction map.

For the isomorphism s, the standard pullback unit is bijective on top sections: apply bijective_pullbackUnit_app_of_isOpenImmersion, since the range is all of A. Define deltaM and deltaN as its inverse equivalences. No arbitrary existence witness is used for these starting coordinates.

View the s-unit as a linear bijection Gamma(A,L) to the restriction of Gamma(T,s*L) along s.appTop. Restriction along this ring isomorphism is an equivalence, so its extension/restriction counit is an isomorphism. Extend the unit bijection and compose with this counit. The resulting isomorphism i1 sends 1 tensor m to the s-unit of m. Apply extendScalarsComp and extend i1 along r to get i from scalar extension along r composed with s.appTop to scalar extension along r of Gamma(T,s*L). Its pure-tensor formula follows from the scalar-extension composition and counit unit formulas.

Compose the inverse of i with the canonical affine comparison for q and r composed with s.appTop. Both are S-linear when the destination is restricted along rho, so this gives the stated semilinearity. Since s-unit(delta(m))=m, the formula for i shows i inverse(1 tensor m)=1 tensor delta(m); the canonical affine comparison gives the required q-unit formula. Apply this construction to M and N, using the fixed inverses selected before W,q,S,r,rho, and pair the results.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_isomorphic_source_normalized_models
    {A T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine A] (s : T ⟶ A) [IsIso s]
    (M N : A.Modules) (hMq : M.IsQuasicoherent) (hNq : N.IsQuasicoherent) :
    let P := ModuleCat.of Γ(T, ⊤) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback s).obj M, ⊤)
    let Q := ModuleCat.of Γ(T, ⊤) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback s).obj N, ⊤)
    ∃ (δM : (P : Type u) ≃ Γ(M, ⊤)) (δN : (Q : Type u) ≃ Γ(N, ⊤)),
      ∀ (W : Scheme.{u}) (_ : IsAffine W) (q : W ⟶ A)
        (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (r : Γ(T, ⊤) →+* S) (ρ : S ≃+* Γ(W, ⊤)),
        (∀ b, ρ (r (s.appTop b)) = q.appTop b) →
        ∃ (eM : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj P ≃+
            Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj M, ⊤))
          (eN : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj Q ≃+
            Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj N, ⊤)),
          (∀ b z, eM (b • z) = ρ b • eM z) ∧
          (∀ b z, eN (b • z) = ρ b • eN z) ∧
          (∀ m, eM ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[Γ(T, ⊤), r] m) = pullbackΓ q M (δM m)) ∧
          (∀ m, eN ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[Γ(T, ⊤), r] m) = pullbackΓ q N (δN m))
